item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Hydration. Your day's got early morning routines, checkpoints scattered through the afternoon, and evening wind-down on the schedule — none of that runs well on a dry tank. Caffeine and stress both pull water out of you faster than you'd think, and a packed day makes it easy to forget the basics. Action: fill a bottle right now and finish it before your next appointment.
